text.tspan: MAIN WIRING · one controller at the centre · one conductor per route
Selected controller build: follow each named terminal and match every route ID to the evidence list below.
DOTTED = GUESS / proposed wire; verify before connecting
OPEN = no connection until the missing evidence is obtained
Crossing lines are not junctions. Only named terminal circles are connection points. Repeated controller labels are contact references, not extra physical pins.
Selected machine retrofit · individual contact references

g.title: C01-001 · X min endstop signal · Trace cable with power isolated; confirm dry contact and NO/NC state. Leave selector pin 1 unused for passive switches; powered sensors require a matched interface.
C01-002 · X min endstop GND · Trace cable with power isolated; confirm dry contact and NO/NC state. Leave selector pin 1 unused for passive switches; powered sensors require a matched interface.
C02-001 · Y min endstop signal · Trace cable with power isolated; confirm dry contact and NO/NC state. Leave selector pin 1 unused for passive switches; powered sensors require a matched interface.
C02-002 · Y min endstop GND · Trace cable with power isolated; confirm dry contact and NO/NC state. Leave selector pin 1 unused for passive switches; powered sensors require a matched interface.

C03-001 · J35.6 · PWM candidate · Teardown photo board 20231103 is a reference, not proof of the 20 W fitted board. Laser connector conductors are not assigned from red/black/yellow colours. Obtain matching head/controller pinout, command threshold and flame/tilt/key/E-stop circuit before laser operation.

C03-001 · J35.6 · PWM candidate · Teardown photo board 20231103 is a reference, not proof of the 20 W fitted board. Laser connector conductors are not assigned from red/black/yellow colours. Obtain matching head/controller pinout, command threshold and flame/tilt/key/E-stop circuit before laser operation.

C03-002 · J35.10 · reference candidate · Teardown photo board 20231103 is a reference, not proof of the 20 W fitted board. Laser connector conductors are not assigned from red/black/yellow colours. Obtain matching head/controller pinout, command threshold and flame/tilt/key/E-stop circuit before laser operation.

C03-002 · J35.10 · reference candidate · Teardown photo board 20231103 is a reference, not proof of the 20 W fitted board. Laser connector conductors are not assigned from red/black/yellow colours. Obtain matching head/controller pinout, command threshold and flame/tilt/key/E-stop circuit before laser operation.
C04-001 · X max signal · Firsthand SF-A9 reference reports switches at both ends. Trace this individual switch and return; combined original harness ordering is not assigned from photographs.
C04-002 · X max GND · Firsthand SF-A9 reference reports switches at both ends. Trace this individual switch and return; combined original harness ordering is not assigned from photographs.
C05-001 · Y max signal · Firsthand SF-A9 reference reports switches at both ends. Trace this individual switch and return; combined original harness ordering is not assigned from photographs.
C05-002 · Y max GND · Firsthand SF-A9 reference reports switches at both ends. Trace this individual switch and return; combined original harness ordering is not assigned from photographs.

C06-001 · Prime regulated logic supply · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C06-002 · Prime logic supply return · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C06-003 · Protected motor branch input · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C06-004 · Prime VMOT power · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C06-005 · Prime motor supply return · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C07-001 · Conditional pump power-stage supply · Manufacturer manual pp.3–6 names air-pump port but gives no pump rating or terminal map. Identify DC/AC pump supply and installed connector before choosing a rated isolated switching stage. J20 Fan2 is a conditional DC load candidate only at matched VFET/current rating; existing laser-head command resource remains separate.

C07-001 · Conditional pump power-stage supply · Manufacturer manual pp.3–6 names air-pump port but gives no pump rating or terminal map.
